hero.title: The
hero.description: A high-precision path from a simple idea to a scalable production environment. Transparency is built into every step.

steps.title: Discovery & Alignment
steps.description: Every great project starts with the right communication. This is where we test the compatibility of your vision with my technical expertise.
steps.action: You submit project details via the form or schedule a 15-30 min Discovery Call.
steps.result: We agree on project goals, budget range, and tech stack (Web, Mobile, Architecture).

steps.title: Proposal & Agreement
steps.description: Scope is defined and the professional framework is set. No room for surprise costs or extended timelines.
steps.action: You receive a detailed proposal including timeline, tech stack, and payment schedule.
steps.result: Proposal approved, deposit paid, and the development calendar is locked.

steps.title: The Onboarding
steps.description: This is where we depart from the standard freelancer experience. You step into the project's command center.
steps.action: A client account is created for you on portal.poyrazavsever.com immediately after agreement.
steps.result: All your contracts, invoices, meeting notes, and project progress become accessible in one secure panel.

steps.title: Requirements & UI/UX
steps.description: Before writing code, we draw a flawless plan of what we are building.
steps.action: You submit brand assets (logo, text, colors) and a detailed brief via the Portal.
steps.result: High-fidelity Figma designs and prototypes are prepared. You see and approve the finished look before coding begins.

steps.title: Development, QA & Launch
steps.description: The final stage where design comes to life and the project goes live.
steps.action: Development sprints begin. You track transparently via Portal. We perform QA testing on staging servers.
steps.result: Project is launched to Production. Source code and docs delivered. Optional transition to Retainer/Maintenance.

cta.title: Ready to start this journey?
cta.description: Now that you know how we work, let's discuss your project.
